This is the G6 precondition concept_coverage_ok; H3A may not be raised and no p7-* task for ep01 may be dispatched until it reads 100%.

_meta.verification_method: Every claimed in-stock path was stat-ed on disk and its pixel dimensions read from the file header (no inference from naming convention). The bundled Pillow is unavailable to this shell, so image size was parsed directly from the JPEG SOF / PNG IHDR header; note that genmedia writes JPEG payloads under .png names, which is expected and not a fault. Scene layout packs were additionally machine-checked with the host CLI `python3 code/blocking_map_check.py --project alices --ep ep01`.
_meta.not_my_job: This audit only decides WHAT is missing and WHICH views are needed. It does not draw anything and does not dispatch. Refills route through the orchestrator to 06-art/character-concept / environment-concept / prop / creature-concept. The user's auto-rerun budget is 0, so any gap found here is a user decision, not an automatic refill.

required_view_conventions.note: Stated once here; the per-entity rows below carry only their own values.

character.base: assets/concepts/characters/<CHAR-id>/sheet.png — the full four-panel identity sheet, mandatory for every character in the episode.
character.age_version: If the episode uses a non-default age version, that version's base sheet (sheet_<version>.png) is additionally required. ep01 uses CHAR-alice-age01 only; sheet_age02.png belongs to ep09 and is out of ep01 scope.
character.costume: Per section 6A (2026-08-26), a sheet_<COS-id>.png is required only for each NON-DEFAULT costume that this episode's costumes_by_char points to. Every ep01 costume is the character's default outfit and is carried by sheet.png itself, so ep01 requires zero separate costume sheets. Judged from each character's costume_sheets.json ledger, not from filenames.

creature.stage_variant: sheet_<stage>.png is required only when the episode's chapters cross a stage boundary in creature.json forms[].since_chapter or mount.json endurance_state_log. CRE-001 has exactly one form (stage 'waking-real', since ch001) and the project registers zero mounts, so no stage variant is required anywhere in ep01.

scene.required: The layout pack = assets/concepts/scenes/<SCN-id>/layout_top.png + layout.json, both required.
scene.retired: grid_9views.png is retired (2026-09-09) and is not counted. Legacy single-angle main_*.png would count as a gap; none of the ep01 scenes carries one, and none is needed.

prop.required: For a plot prop: the card in bible/props.json plus assets/concepts/props/<PROP-id>/main_01.png (look) and scale_ref_01.png (the scale anchor that Phase 7 attaches to group refs).
